head: The wake lock
with an
expiry date.
body: I added a one hour timeout so it could never leak. Then I searched for the line that renews it.

head: The guard who reads
*the paperwork
slides.caption: Not cruel, just by the book. He doesn't mind a lock you hold. He notices the one that quietly ran out.

head: One acquire,
one deadline
callout: One call site, in the trip-start path.
Nothing runs at minute 59 to renew it.

head: Two sets of numbers,
one of them live
body: LocationTrackingConstants.kt declares its own wake lock tag and a ten minute maximum. No Kotlin file in the repo references either.
The real timeout is a private constant in a different file. Grep for it and you find the wrong one first.

head: A timeout is
a leak guard.
*It is also a cliff.
body: I haven't measured minute 61, so I won't invent what happens there.
Renew it on a schedule you can name, or write down why expiry is fine.
